anim_set_lock.FIGHT: every move in this file: moveset moves and combat stances — the combat animation bank
anim_set_lock.SHOW: win poses, intro poses, taunts, cutscene animations — intro/win slots and cutscenes ONLY; tracked in docs/anim/BOB-ANIM-GAP-20261023.md; must NEVER enter this moveset without the user's explicit approval
anim_set_lock.note: per-move 'set' tags stamp what each pull lane added; the file itself is the FIGHT set

frame_convention: T3 60fps -> seconds; damage scaled T3 170HP -> WH 100HP

generated_full_moveset.note: Full T3 bank depth merged over curated base; curated moves preserved verbatim. Smallest T3 bank (365 rows, 188 attacks); 79 attack rows have no per-character input in the extracted data (common-bank / reaction rows). Unique playable inputs top out at ~90-97 per fighter.

canon_note: Base form only (burger-demon kits were done separately in PR #337, untouched); T8 Bob frame data folded in.

forward_merge.method: semantic union of branch (moveset-cluster-a-t8) and main versions; main keeps contested move keys, branch entries rekeyed <key>_t8 with t8_input recorded; colliding branch specials appended with forward_merge_alt_of

expansion.note: Additive expansion from real T3 teardown bank rows. Existing moves untouched.
